verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents a self-serve sandbox, fully separate from production, that covers all products except Connected Account APIs, with per-product simulation docs and an end-to-end sandbox quickstart. The developer MCP can also simulate events. However, the pack never mentions test card numbers, decline scenarios, or dispute simulation. Missing for 10: documented test cards for declines and other scenarios, dispute simulation in sandbox, and independent hands-on corroboration that the sandbox mirrors production.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build and test the entire payment flow in a sandbox or test mode that mirrors production, with test cards for every scenario including declines and disputes

citations.quote: Airwallex provides a sandbox environment, completely separate from the production environment, for testing your integration through simulations without using real money. It gives you access to all products in the Airwallex web app and API (except Connected Account APIs)
Complete a minimal end-to-end online payment in the sandbox environment using Airwallex.js and Airwallex-hosted payment page.
create test resources, simulate events, and call sandbox endpoints
